policy: Source-context review before any model predictions. Accept reviewed exact saved anchor targets. Resolve clear aliases and coreference from source context. NONE means no correct identity in the entire same-page A pool. Entity types do not constrain identity. Related entities and parent works are not identical. Ambiguous fragments, event/place ambiguity and uncertain demonyms remain unverified. This is an assistant source review, not a second human annotation.
